# Strum Media

> Melbourne-based video production, photography and drone content studio. Strum Media creates cinematic video, professional photography, aerial/drone footage, social media content, podcasting and ongoing content for construction, property, corporate and consumer brands — based in Melbourne and servicing all of Australia.

## About
- [About Strum Media](https://www.strummedia.com.au/about): Who we are, our mission, our team and the clients we work with.
- [Contact](https://www.strummedia.com.au/contact): Enquiries — phone +61 429 267 428, email admin@strummarketing.com.au.

## Services
- [Videography](https://www.strummedia.com.au/service-videography): Cinematic video production for projects, brands and campaigns.
- [Photography](https://www.strummedia.com.au/service-photography): Professional stills for sites, products, teams and listings.
- [Aerial & Drone](https://www.strummedia.com.au/service-aerial-drone): Aerial video and photography for sites, property and infrastructure.
- [Social Media Management](https://www.strummedia.com.au/service-social-media-management): Ongoing social content, strategy and management.
- [Podcasting](https://www.strummedia.com.au/service-podcasting): Podcast filming, recording and production.
- [Content Creation](https://www.strummedia.com.au/service-content-creation): Reels, short-form and ongoing content.
- [All services](https://www.strummedia.com.au/services): Overview of everything Strum Media offers.

## Industries
- [Construction](https://www.strummedia.com.au/construction-media): Progress films, site photography and aerial content for builders and contractors.
- [Property Developments](https://www.strummedia.com.au/developments-media): Video, photography and aerial for residential and commercial developments.
- [Residential Developments](https://www.strummedia.com.au/residential-development-media): Content for apartments, townhouses and house-and-land developers.
- [Real Estate](https://www.strummedia.com.au/real-estate-media): Property tours, listing photography and aerial for agents and agencies.
- [Infrastructure](https://www.strummedia.com.au/infrastructure-media): Aerial, progress documentation and photography for major civil projects.
- [Government](https://www.strummedia.com.au/government-media): Public-sector project documentation and communications content.
- [Corporate](https://www.strummedia.com.au/corporate-media): Brand, culture and campaign content for corporate teams.
- [Demolition](https://www.strummedia.com.au/demolition-media): Documentation and aerial for demolition and site works.
- [Medical & Healthcare](https://www.strummedia.com.au/medical-media): Photography, video and social content for clinics and practices.
- [Automotive](https://www.strummedia.com.au/automotive-media): Photography, video, reels and content for dealerships and automotive brands.
- [Hospitality](https://www.strummedia.com.au/hospitality-media): Content for venues, restaurants and hospitality brands.
- [Retail & Consumer](https://www.strummedia.com.au/retail-media): Content for retail and consumer brands.
- [Personal Brand](https://www.strummedia.com.au/personal-brand-media): Content and media for personal and founder brands.
